## Audio Overviews

Audio Overviews help you understand your material on the go.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/KLEBmbDGYE8?si=N3910k6QuS3UWAQ8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Format options:

**Deep dive**: A lively conversation between two hosts, unpacking and connecting topics in your sources

**Brief**: A bite-sized overview to help you grasp the core ideas from your sources quickly

**Critique**: An expert review of your sources, offering constructive feedback to help you improve your material

**Debate**: A thoughtful debate between two hosts, illuminating different perspectives on your sources


<!-- ::: {.callout-note}

[Slides](https://kirenz.github.io/notebooklm/notebooklm-audio-overview#/title-slide) 

::: -->

## Video-Overview

You can think of these as a visual alternative to Audio Overviews: the AI host creates new visuals to help illustrate points while also pulling in images, diagrams, quotes and numbers from your documents. 

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/KA_pExdDSUo?si=Gl0bwSSiX0C4I-7g" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Report

<!-- Automatically create different content types.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3kQD3briELY?si=eJmeEvI66N_D_i4Q" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe> -->

Formats:

- **Create your own**: Craft reports your way by specifying structure, style, tone and more

- **Briefing doc**: Overview of your sources featuring key insights and quotes

- **Study guide**: Short-answer quiz, suggested essay questions and glossary of key terms

- **FAQ**: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) generates a list of common questions and their answers, providing quick information on a specific topic.


- **Timeline**: Timeline: Create a detailed timeline of the main events covered in these sources, followed by a cast of characters listing the principle people

- **Blog post**: Insightful takeaways distilled into a highly readable article

## Flashcards

Memorize key terms, important dates and core concepts from your sources.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/EZ6MM_orQTw?si=TQAbBqfyb1rPBnp2" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Flashcards give you the option to dig deeper; just click “explain” and Gemini Notebook will generate a detailed overview, helping you understand a flashcard definition, with citations pointing back to the original source material.

 ::: {.callout-note}

[Slides](https://kirenz.github.io/notebooklm/notebooklm-flashcards#/title-slide) 

::: 

---


## Quiz

Test your comprehension and challenge yourself with custom questions based on your material.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/WTHf5apaCzI?si=99GWIltUyjvuJVxY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

You can customize the topic, set the difficulty and share your study sets with colleagues with a simple link.

Just click “explain” and Gemini Notebook will generate a detailed overview, explaining why you got a quiz question wrong, with citations pointing back to the original source material.

[Slides](https://kirenz.github.io/notebooklm/notebooklm-report#/title-slide)
